mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(s.subject_id) as totalCourses, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.is_active = 1 AND s.status = 'active' THEN 1 END) as activeCourses, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.is_active = 1 THEN a.assignment_count ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalAssignments FROM subject s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT subject_id, COUNT(*) as assignment_count FROM assignment GROUP BY subject_id ) a ON s.subject_id = a.subject_id
SELECT MAX(academic_year) FROM subject WHERE is_active = 1
